regime_limit: Four month-spanning OOS periods are not automatic proof of four independent economic regimes; characterize train-only state distribution and serial dependence before P1 acceptance.
history: July15-22 inspected development; V7 A August12-19 executed six recipes; V7 B September16-23 executed two. Their outputs are preserved and registered, never renamed pristine unseen. New V8 endpoints overlap some historical fitting/validation dates and require full trial-history correction, not a clean-room research claim.
lag_rule: Use max(600s, observed actual maturity lag); strict actual cutoff < validation_start - embargo - max_lag. Purge immature labels. Validation maturity < test_start - embargo.
common_inputs: One fixed feature specification, identical rows/splits/scalers/cost/risk/frequency between nonoverlap signal and direct return. Original 68 past features are the causal starting point; all V8 specified multiscale additions must be fixed jointly before model/outcome access, not selected from these tests.
oracle_observed_flow_role: Mechanism diagnostic only; never a deployable predictor or tradable ceiling.

P1_acceptance.direction: Freeze the economic direction from train-only fit; >=3/4 OOS effects agree, no test-dependent sign inversion or target selection. Both signs must be registered as separate hypotheses if tested.
P1_acceptance.incremental_baseline: Paired STANDARD_TAKER net result exceeds matched DIRECT_RETURN and strongest feasible risk-matched benchmark; if benchmark implementation or comparable executable inputs missing, NOT_READY.
P1_acceptance.confidence_interval: Dependence-aware paired daily/block bootstrap; clearly negative upper95% bound fails P1, a straddling interval is inconclusive. Positive mean alone never grants candidate qualification; corrected positive lower bound is required for later candidate gate.
P1_acceptance.break_even_cost: At least predeclared 30bp total roundtrip baseline, with 32/36bp sensitivity separately reported; do not rescue via LOW_FEE_TAKER or altered risk.
P1_acceptance.concentration: Predeclare before outcomes: >=20 total closed trades, >=5 in each fold, >=12 active UTC days; positive gross-PnL share top1day<=25%, top5days<=65%, top1trade<=20%, top10trades<=65%. Report gross positive-share plus signed net attribution and zero/negative-total cases, never cancel large losses to inflate denominators.
P1_acceptance.multiple_testing: A complete run/config/seed/threshold/direction history is required. Legacy artifact inventory alone is insufficient to count trials; DSR/PBO/CSCV/SPA or White Reality Check must not be reported as passed while inputs are unknown.
P1_acceptance.execution: close/open proxies can falsify a screening hypothesis; cannot establish executable alpha without causal BBO, depth, latency and size evidence. Maker/carry remain NOT_EVALUABLE when inputs are missing.

bootstrap.primary_unit: UTC daily paired incremental PnL/exposure ledger
bootstrap.block_length_rule: ceil(max(label horizon, actual maximum holding period, conservatively estimated autocorrelation horizon) / sampling interval), at least one day for daily resampling
bootstrap.library_policy: Use mature published implementations for stationary/block bootstrap, SPA and CSCV/DSR where compatible; only thin adapters, no new statistical framework. If not available, mark NOT_EVALUABLE until verified reuse is integrated.

allowed_reopen: real L1/L5/BBO information with new predeclared contract
failure_action.forbidden: more model families or test-driven tuning of the same failed labels
